args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed with status "rolled_out".

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate down to 0.002.
